message.content:
**“Still in Love with You”** is a **Brooks & Dunn** song from their 1991 album **_Brand New Man_**.[2][3] The lyrics begin with “*My taxicab is waiting / Wish I could hold you one last time*,” which matches the song you’re looking for.[1][2]
